tamam tarr tareef uss Allah ki hai jiss ki sift yeh hai kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , sabb ussi ka hai , aur aakhirat mein bhi tareef ussi ki hai , aur wohi hai jo hikmat ka malik hai , mukammal tor per ba-khabar !

woh unn cheezon ko bhi janta hai jo zameen kay andar jati hain , aur unn ko bhi jo uss say bahir nikalti hain , unn ko bhi jo aasman say utarti hain , aur unn ko bhi jo uss mein charrti hain , aur wohi hai jo bara meharban hai , boht bakhshney wala hai .

aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh kehtay hain kay :  hum per qayamat nahi aaye gi  keh do :  kiyon nahi aaye gi ? meray aalam-ul-ghaib perwerdigar ki qasam ! woh tum per zaroor aa-ker rahey gi . koi zarra barabar cheez uss ki nazar say door nahi hoti ,   naa aasmano mein , naa zameen mein , aur naa uss say choti koi cheez aesi hai naa bari jo aik khuli kitab ( yani loah-e-mehfooz ) mein darj naa ho .
. ( aur qayamat iss liye aaye gi ) takay jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , Allah unn ko inaam dey . aesay logon  kay liye maghfirat hai , aur ba-izzat rizq .
aur jinn logon  ney humari aayaton kay baaray mein yeh koshish ki hai kay unhen nakam banayen , unn kay liye bala ka dardnak azab hai .

aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jinn logon  ko ilm ata huwa hai , woh khoob samajhtay hain kay tum per tumharay rab ki taraf say jo kuch nazil kiya gaya hai , woh haq hai , aur uss ( Allah ) ka raasta dikhata hai jo iqtidar ka malik bhi hai , her tareef ka mustahiq bhi .

aur yeh kafir log ( aik doosray say ) kehney lagay :  kiya hum tumhen aik aesay shaks ka pata batayen jo tumhen yeh khabar deta hai kay jab tum ( mar ker ) bilkul reza reza hochuko gay uss waqt tum aik naye janam mein aao gay ?

pata nahi uss shaks ney Allah per jhoot baandha hai , ya ussay kissi tarah ka junoon laahaq hai ?  nahi ! balkay haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay woh khud azab mein aur perlay darjay ki gumrahi mein mubtala hain .

bhala kiya inn logon  ney uss aasman o zameen ko nahi dekha jo unn kay aagay bhi mojood hain , aur unn kay peechay bhi . agar hum chahen to unn ko zameen mein dhansa den , ya aasman kay kuch tukrray unn per gira den . haqeeqat yeh hai kay iss mein her uss banday kay liye aik nishani hai jo Allah ki taraf rujoo kernay wala ho .

aur waqiaa yeh hai kay hum ney dawood ko khaas apney paas say fazal ata kiya tha .  aey paharo ! tum bhi tasbeeh mein unn kay sath hum aawaz ban jao , aur aey parindon ! tum bhi .  aur hum ney unn kay liye lohey ko naram ker diya tha ,
kay :  poori poori zirhen banao , aur karriyan jorrney mein tawazun say kaam lo ,   aur tum sabb log naik amal kero . tum jo amal bhi kertay ho , mein ussay dekh raha hun .

aur suleman kay liye hum ney hawa ko tabey bana diya tha . uss ka subha ka safar bhi aik maheenay ki musafat ka hota tha , aur shaam ka safar bhi aik maheenay ki musafat ka .   aur hum ney unn kay liye tanbay ka chashma baha diya tha .   aur jinnaat mein say kuch woh thay jo apney perwerdigar kay hukum say unn kay aagay kaam kertay thay ,   aur ( hum ney unn per yeh baat wazeh kerdi thi kay ) unn mein say jo koi humaray hukum say hatt ker tairrah raasta ikhtiyar keray ga , ussay hum bharakti hoi aag ka maza chakhayen gay .

woh jinnaat suleman kay liye jo woh chahtay bana diya kertay thay : oonchi oonchi imaraten , tasweeren ,   hoz jaisay baray baray lagan aur zameen mein jami hoi degen ! :  aey dawood kay khandan walo ! tum aesay amal kiya kero jinn say shukar zahir ho . aur meray bandon mein kam log hain jo shukar guzar hon .

phir jab hum ney suleman ki moat ka faisla kiya to unn jinnaat ko unn ki moat ka pata kissi aur ney nahi balkay zameen kay keeray ney diya jo unn kay asaa ko kha raha tha .   chunacheh jab woh gir parray to jinnaat ko maloom huwa kay agar woh ghaib ka ilm jantay hotay to iss zillat wali takleef mein mubtala naa rehtay .

haqeeqat yeh hai kay qoam-e-saba kay liye khud uss jagah aik nishani mojood thi jahan woh raha kertay thay ,   dayen aur bayen dono taraf baaghon kay do silsilay thay ! :  apney perwerdigar ka diya huwa rizq khao , aur uss ka shukar baja lao , aik to shehar behtareen , doosray perwerdigar bakhshney wala !

phir bhi unhon ney ( hidayat say ) mun morr liya , iss liye hum ney unn per band wala saylaab chorr diya , aur unn kay dono taraf kay baaghon ko aesay do baaghon mein tabdeel kerdiya jo bad-maza phalon , jahao kay darakhton aur thori si bairiyon per mushtamil thay .
yeh saza hum ney unn ko iss liye di kay unhon ney nashukri ki rawish ikhtiyar ki thi , aur aesi saza hum kissi aur ko nahi , baray baray nashukron hi ko diya kertay hain .

aur hum ney unn kay aur unn bastiyon kay darmiyan jinn per hum ney barkaten nazil ki hain ,   aesi bastiyan basa rakhi then jo door say nazar aati then , aur unn mein safar ko napay tulay marhalon mein baant diya tha   ( aur kaha tha kay )  inn ( bastiyon ) kay darmiyan raaten hon ya din , aman o aman kay sath safar kero

iss per woh kehney lagay kay :  humaray perwerdigar ! humaray safar ki manzilon kay darmiyan door door kay faslay peda kerday  aur yun unhon ney apni janon per sitam dhaaya , jiss kay nateejay mein hum ney unhen afsana hi afsana bana diya , aur unhen tukrray tukrray ker kay bilkul tittar-bittar kerdiya .   yaqeenan iss waqaey mein her uss shaks kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo sabar o shukar ka khoogar ho .
aur waqaee inn logon  kay baaray mein iblees ney apna khayal durust paya ,   chunacheh yeh ussi kay peechay chal parray , siwaye uss giroh kay jo momin tha .

aur iblees ko unn per koi tasallut nahi tha , albatta hum ( ney uss ko behkaney ki salahiyat iss liye di thi kay ) hum yeh dekhna chahtay thay kay kon hai jo aakhirat per emaan lata hai , aur kon hai jo uss kay baaray mein shak mein parra huwa hai .   aur tumhara perwerdigar her cheez per nigran hai .

. ( aey payghumber ! inn kafiron say ) kaho kay :  pukaro unn ko jinhen tum ney Allah kay siwa khuda samjha huwa hai . woh aasmano aur zameen mein zarra barabar kissi cheez kay malik nahi hain , naa unn ko aasman o zameen kay moamlaat mein ( Allah kay sath ) koi shirkat hasil hai , aur naa unn mein say koi Allah ka madadgaar hai .

aur Allah kay samney koi sifarish kaar-aamad nahi hai , siwaye uss shaks kay jiss kay liye khud uss ney ( sifarish ki ) ijazat dey di ho , yahan tak kay jab unn kay dilon say ghabrahat door kerdi jati hai to woh kehtay hain kay :  tumharay rab ney kiya farmaya-? woh jawab detay hain kay :  haq baat irshad farmaee , aur wohi hai jo bara aalishaan hai .
kaho kay :  kon hai jo tumhen aasmano say aur zameen say rizq deta hai ?  kaho :  woh Allah hai ! aur hum hon ya tum , ya to hidayat per hain , ya khuli gumrahi mein mubtala hain .
kaho kay :  hum ney jo jurm kiya ho , uss kay baaray mein tum say nahi poocha jaye ga , aur tum jo amal kertay ho , uss kay baaray mein hum say sawal nahi hoga .
kaho kay :  humara perwerdigar hum sabb ko jama keray ga , phir humaray darmiyan bar-haq faisla keray ga , aur wohi hai jo khoob faislay kernay wala , mukammal ilm ka malik hai .

kaho kay :  zara mujhay dikhao woh kon hain jinhen tum ney shareek bana ker Allah say jorr rakha hai . hergiz nahi ! ( uss ka koi shareek nahi hai ) balkay woh Allah hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .
aur ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumhen saray hi insanon kay liye aisa Rasool bana ker bheja hai jo khushkhabri bhi sunaye , aur khabrdar bhi keray , lekin aksar log samajh nahi rahey hain .
aur ( tum say ) kehtay hain kay :  agar tum sachay ho to yeh ( qayamat ka ) wada kab poora hoga-?
keh do kay :  tumharay liye aik aesay din ki miyaad muqarrar hai jiss say tum gharri barabar naa peechay hatt saktay ho , naa aagay jasaktay ho .

aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , woh kehtay hain kay :  hum naa to iss Quran per kabhi emaan layen gay , aur naa unn ( aasmani kitabon ) per jo iss say pehlay hoi hain .  aur agar tum uss waqt ka manzar dekho jab yeh zalim log apney perwerdigar kay samney kharray kiye jayen gay , to yeh aik doosray per baat daal rahey hon gay . jinn logon  ko ( duniya mein ) kamzor samjha gaya tha woh unn say kahen gay jo baray banay huye thay kay :  agar tum naa hotay to hum zaroor momin ban jatay .

jo baray banay huye thay , unn say kahen gay jinhen kamzor samjha gaya tha kay :  kiya hum ney tumhen hidayat say roka tha jabkay woh tumharay paas aa-chuki thi ? asal baat yeh hai kay tum khud mujrim thay .

aur jinhen kamzor samjha gaya tha woh unn say kahen gay jo baray banay huye thay kay :  nahi , yeh tumhari raat din ki makkaari hi to thi ( jiss ney hamen roka tha ) jab tum hamen takeed kertay thay kay hum Allah say kufr ka moamla keren , aur uss kay sath ( doosron ko ) shareek maanen .  aur yeh sabb jab azab ko dekh len gay to apna pachtawa chupa rahey hon gay .   aur jinn jinn logon  ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya tha , hum unn sabb kay galon mein toq daal den gay . unn ko kissi aur baat ka nahi , unhi aemal ka badla diya jaye ga jo woh kiya kertay thay .

aur jiss kissi basti mein hum ney koi khabrdar kernay wala payghumber bheja , uss kay khush haal logon  ney yehi kaha kay :  jiss paygham kay sath tumhen bheja gaya hai , hum uss ko manney say inkar kertay hain .
aur kaha kay :  hum maal aur aulad mein tum say ziyada hain aur hamen azab honey wala nahi hai .
keh do kay :  mera perwerdigar jiss kay liye chahta hai , rizq ki farawaani ker deta hai , aur ( jiss kay liye chahta hai ) tangi ker deta hai , lekin aksar log iss baat ko samajhtay nahi hain .

aur naa tumharay maal tumhen humarey huzoor koi qurb ata kertay hain aur naa tumhari aulad . haan magar jo emaan laye aur naik amal keray to aesay logon  ko unn kay amal ka dohra sawab milay ga , aur woh ( jannat kay ) bala-khanon mein chain keren gay .
aur jo log humari aayaton kay baaray mein yeh koshish kertay hain kay unn ko nakam banayen , unn ko azab mein dhar liya jaye ga .

keh do kay :  mera perwerdigar apney bandon mein say jiss kay liye chahta hai rizq ki farawaani ker deta hai , aur ( jiss kay liye chahta hai ) tangi ker deta hai . aur tum jo cheez bhi kharch kertay ho , woh uss ki jagah aur cheez dey deta hai , aur wohi sabb say behtar rizq denay wala hai .
aur woh din naa bhoolo jab Allah inn sabb ko jama keray ga , phir farishton say kahey ga kay :  kiya yeh log waqaee tumhari ibadat kiya kertay thay ?

woh kahen gay kay :  hum to aap ki zaat ki paki biyan kertay hain , humara talluq aap say hai , inn logon  say nahi . darasal yeh to jinnaat ki ibadat kiya kertay thay .   unn mein say aksar log unhi kay moataqid thay .

lehaza aaj tum mein say koi naa kissi ko koi faeeda phonchaney ka ikhtiyar rakhta hai , naa nuqsan phonchaney ka . aur jinn logon  ney zulm ki rawish ikhtiyar ki thi , unn say hum kahen gay kay :  uss aag ka maza chakho jiss ko tum jhutlaya kiya kertay thay .

aur jab humari aayaten jo mukammal wazahat ki hamil hain unn ko parh ker sunai jati hain to yeh ( humaray payghumber kay baaray mein ) kehtay hain kay :  kuch nahi , yeh shaks bus yeh chahta hai kay tum logon  ko unn maboodon say bargushta kerday jinhen tumharay baap daday poojtay aaye hain .  aur kehtay hain kay :  yeh ( Quran ) kuch bhi nahi , aik mann gharrat jhoot hai .  aur jab inn kafiron kay paas haq ka paygham aaya to unhon ney uss kay baaray mein yeh kaha kay :  yeh to aik khulay jadoo kay siwa kuch nahi hai .
halankay hum ney enhen pehlay naa aesi kitaben di then jo yeh parhtay parhatay hon , aur naa ( aey payghumber ! ) tum say pehlay hum ney inn kay paas koi khabrdar kernay wala ( nabi ) bheja tha .

aur inn say pehlay logon  ney bhi ( payghumberon ) ko jhutlaya tha , aur yeh ( arab kay mushrikeen ) to uss saz-o-saman kay daswen hissay ko bhi nahi phonchay hain jo hum ney unn ( pehlay logon  ) ko dey rakha tha , phir bhi unhon ney meray payghumberon ko jhutlaya , to ( dekh lo kay ) meri di hoi saza kaisi ( sakht ) thi !

. ( aey payghumber ! ) inn say kaho kay :  mein tumhen sirf aik baat ki naseehat kerta hun , aur woh yeh kay tum chahye do do mil ker aur chahye akelay akelay Allah ki khatir uth kharray ho ,   phir ( insaf say ) socho ( to foran samajh mein aajaye ga kay ) tumharay iss sathi ( yani Muhammad SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) mein junoon ki koi baat bhi to nahi hai . woh to aik sakht azab kay aaney say pehlay tumhen khabrdar ker-rahey hain .
kaho :  mein ney agar iss baat per tum say koi ujrat maangi ho to woh tumhari hai . mera ajar to Allah kay siwa kissi kay zimmay nahi hai , aur woh her cheez ka mushaeeda kernay wala hai .
keh do kay :  mera perwerdigar haq ko oopper say bhej raha hai ,   woh ghaib ki sari baaton ko khoob janney wala hai .
keh do kay :  haq aa-chuka hai , aur batil mein naa kuch shuroo kernay ka dum hai , naa dobara kernay ka .

keh do kay :  agar mein raastay say bhatka hun to meray bhatakney ka nuqsan mujhi ko hoga , aur agar mein ney seedha raasta paaliya hai to yeh uss wahi ki badolat hai jo mera rab mujh per nazil ker raha hai . woh yaqeenan sabb kuch sunney wala , her aik say qareeb hai .

. ( aey payghumber ! tumhen unn ki halat ajeeb nazar aaye gi ) agar tum woh manzar dekho jab yeh ghabraye phirtay hon gay , aur bhag nikalney ka koi raasta nahi hoga , aur unhen qareeb hi say pakar liya jaye ga .
aur ( uss waqt ) yeh kahen gay kay :  hum iss per emaan ley aaye hain  , halankay itni door jagah say unn ko koi cheez kaisay haath aa-sakti hai ?
jabkay unhon ney pehlay iss ka inkar kiya tha , aur door door say atkal pacho teer phenka kertay thay .

aur uss waqt yeh jiss ( emaan ) ki aarzoo keren gay , uss kay aur inn kay darmiyan aik aarr kerdi jaye gi , jaisa kay inn jaisay jo log inn say pehlay huye hain , unn kay sath bhi yehi moamla hoga . haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh sabb aesay shak mein parray huye thay jiss ney enhen dhokay mein daal rakha tha .
